name: greenhouse
shortDescription: Hilbish's environmentally friendly pager for long text
description:
Greenhouse is a simple text scrolling handler (pager) for terminal programs.
It can be set a specific region to do its scrolling and paging job,
then the user can draw whatever outside it. You may use this as some kind
of terminal UI library.

docs.name: render
description: This should be overloaded to render extra UI around Greenhouse.

docs.name: resize
description: Resizes Greenhouse to fit the terminal's size.

docs.name: scroll
description: Scrolls the currently active page by one line, or a page height if specified.

Keys.Name: page
Doc: Whether the scroll amount should be the page height.

docs.name: updateSpecial
description: This function will be called when the special page
is on and needs to be updated.
